REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE Sp. Br. REGISTRY File No. 933 No. 28/8/40 Date August 26, 40）

Subject Shanghai Pawnshop Owners' Association.

Made by D. S. McKeown. Forwarded by D. S. I. Logan.

* Sealo 8857-C++

The Shanghai Pawnshop Owners'
Association was formerly situated at Woo Ka
Loong, Hou Ka Fang, Old North Gate, Nantao.
It was originally known as the Pawnshop
Trade Guild ( 典業公所 ) and was
reorganized in 1931 with the approval of
the defunct local Tangpu and the Bureau
of Social Affairs of the former Shanghai
City Government. It consisted of some
80 members who were all proprietors of the
local pawnshops.

After the outbreak of the local
Sino-Japanese hostilities in 1937, the
association was unable to function in
Nantao, whereupon a communication office
was established in January, 1938 at 250
Burkill Road. Most of the pawnshops
situated in Chinese territory were either
closed or removed into the Settlement and
French Concession. At present, the
association claims to have a total membership
of 49 shops, twenty of which are located
in the French Concession and twenty-nine in
the Settlement. A list of pawnshops in
the Settlement is attached. This association
is not registered with the Police, but has
agreed to do so in the near future.

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特务科 登记室 档案号 933 编号 28/8/40 日期 1940年8月26日）

事由：上海当铺业主公会。

撰写人：D. S. McKeown。转呈人：D. S. I. Logan。

* Sealo 8857-C++

上海当铺业主公会原址位于南市老北门侯家坊吴家弄。该会原名典业公所，于1931年经已解散的地方党部及前上海市政府社会局批准改组而成。其成员约80人，均为本地当铺业主。

1937年当地中日战事爆发后，该会在南市无法运作，遂于1938年1月在伯基路250号设立通讯处。位于华界的大多数当铺要么关闭，要么迁入租界及法租界。目前，该会声称共有会员49家，其中20家位于法租界，29家位于公共租界。附有一份公共租界内当铺名单。该协会未在警务处注册，但已同意在近期办理注册。

We would like to know to what extent the Shanghai
